AllowEdit.Name: Allow Editing
AllowEdit.Hint: Allow messages to be edited (via right click).

Markdown.Name: Markdown Styling
Markdown.Hint: Enable markdown styling of chat messages.

Typing.Name: Typing Indicator
Typing.Hint: Show a Discord-style "is typing" indicator above the chat box when other players are composing a message. A leading "/" (commands and whispers) is never broadcast.

ShowEdited.Name: Show Edited Messages
ShowEdited.Hint: Show a small label on messages that have been edited.
